stemMarkdown: A bag contains 6 red balls and 8 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 6 red balls out of 2 from all 14: $\dfrac{\binom{6}{2}}{\binom{14}{2}} = \dfrac{15}{91} = 0.164835$.
